knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍

knowledge.textEn: Point transform pB=RBC pC+tBC requires translation in frame B; small angular error produces transverse offset approximately L δθ.

optionsEn: Apply the inverse transform to recover the camera point; sample varied rotation axes and test target error on held-out poses.
Constant offset suggests translation error; error growing with distance suggests rotation error. Compare two working distances.
Synthetic camera point(10,0,0) mm,90° z rotation and B-frame translation(30,0,0) mm; working distance 500 mm.
